Planning a visa-free stopover in China? A lot of people think it works like a round trip: fly in, then fly home. The transit rule needs an onward ticket to a third country or region — so plan it as home → China → a third country. US and Canadian passports are on the transit list. Entry rules as of Nov 16, 2026. Rules change, so confirm on the official NIA site before you book. Not visa or legal advice.

Paying in China? Mobile payments are widely used there: after linking an international credit card to a payment app, you pay by scanning QR codes in shops, restaurants, taxis and on public transport. One thing to do before you fly: check the logo on your card against the official list. The official payment guide lists Visa, Mastercard, UnionPay, JCB, Diners Club and Discover for both payment apps, and American Express for one of the two. Payment info as of Nov 16, 2026; rules change, so confirm on official sites.
